[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]VCS setup adopts the runner's existing workspace[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]adopt-runner-workspace[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]adopt-runner-workspace: make the `#git:` and `#gh:` setup steps adopt [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the live numbered RUNNING claim already held by the calling runner [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]instead of allocating a second workspace, treating adoption exactly like[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the existing launcher pre-allocation branch (no second claim, no [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]duplicate occupant record, `should_release=false`), while leaving [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]explicit `n=<num>` pinning and genuinely workspace-less callers on their[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]current allocate path.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Pre-allocation survives shell follow-up launches[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]preallocate-shell-followups[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]preallocate-shell-followups: record the starter's VCS workflow ref in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]shell member meta and thread it through `launch_shell_followup`, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`spawn_family_successor`, and `spawn_detached_child` so a gate-, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]monitor-, or proc-shell follow-up whose composed prompt still carries [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`#gh:`/`#git:` is spawned with the `SASE_<VCS>_PRE_ALLOCATED` env the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]launcher already knows how to emit, instead of silently re-running VCS [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]setup with no pre-allocation.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]One workspace identity per runner[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]single-workspace-identity[dim] · [dim][/dim]after adopt-runner-workspace[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]single-workspace-identity: when a VCS workflow legitimately allocates a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]workspace for a runner that had none (deferred/`#0` launches), rebind [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the runner's own workspace identity to it so `done.json`, the checkout [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]occupant record, monitor start, and shell member meta all name the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]directory the agent actually works in, rather than leaving [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`workspace_num` pointing at the launcher's slot while only [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`step_output.meta_workspace` knows the truth.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]VCS release never frees a workspace the family still holds[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]handoff-safe-vcs-release[dim] · [dim][/dim]after single-workspace-identity[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]handoff-safe-vcs-release: make the `#git:`/`#gh:` release step [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]identity-checked and handoff-aware -- release only a claim this run's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pid still owns, clear only an occupant record naming this run, and skip [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]both entirely when the turn ended by handing off mechanically to a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]monitor, gate, proc shell, pipe, or plan proposal whose follow-up will [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]continue in the same checkout.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#AF87FF][dim]preallocate-shell-followups, single-workspace-identity, [/#AF87FF][/dim]
